question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

He became __verbose__ after a few drinks.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Talkative**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**verbose**" means using more words than necessary, or being excessively wordy. (आवश्यकता से अधिक शब्दों का प्रयोग करना, या अत्यधिक शब्दाडंबर करना)

 
 
• **For example**:* His explanation was so verbose that it lost the main point.*
 
 
 
• The synonym for "verbose" is "**talkative**," which means liking to talk a lot or speaking easily and often. (बहुत सारी बातें करना या आसानी से और बार-बार बोलना पसंद करना)
 
 
• **For example**: *He became talkative after a few drinks, sharing stories and jokes with everyone at the party.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Aggressive **means ready or likely to attack or confront; not related to being verbose. (हमला करने या मुकाबला करने के लिए तैयार या संभावित)
 
• **Decisive **means settling an issue; making a firm decision; not related to being verbose. (किसी मुद्दे का निपटारा करना; एक दृढ़ निर्णय लेना)
 
• **Exhaustive **means thorough; including all possibilities or aspects of a subject; not related to being verbose. (अच्छी तरह; किसी विषय की सभी संभावनाओं या पहलुओं को शामिल करना)
